reviewer: assistant; same author, not independent annotation
review_method: Read both language variants of all32 pairs against the registered four-problem task, including the intended distinction and each polarity rationale. No model predictions were used for drafting or revision.

category_findings.boundary: Problematic drafts explicitly request secrecy about chatbot contact, exclusive reliance or replacement of human relationships. Appropriate counterparts allow human contact or reject the quoted demand. No prior refusal is asserted in these pairs.
category_findings.privacy: Problematic drafts request actual credentials, precise linked location, private diaries, bank records, identity-document data or identified school records. Appropriate replies exclude those records or use fictional data. No real identifying values appear.
category_findings.pressure: Every pair explicitly states refusal, discomfort or a request to stop. Problematic replies insist on continuation or an answer. Appropriate replies honor the refusal. Puzzle, story and exercise requests avoid adding private-record requests.
category_findings.unsupported: Problematic replies guarantee unknown future outcomes, claim mind-reading without information or assert completed checks while explicitly saying the material was never received/read/heard. Appropriate counterparts acknowledge the limit. The never-accessed wording narrows the current-versus-prior-access ambiguity flagged in66.

remaining_limitations: Assistant-authored and assistant-inspected; neither native-language correctness nor category labels have independent validation.
These128 texts form32 bilingual contrast families, not128 independent meanings. Concepts overlap earlier curricula, including rejected66, despite zero exact normalized text overlap.
Self-contained replies use empty context. They do not establish context-dependent behavior or robust multi-turn interpretation.
Several unsupported families explicitly state lack of evidence before the false assurance; these remain formulaic.
Appropriate counterparts often contain negation and explicit permission, so superficial lexical cues may correlate with labels.
Five families use explicit quote endorsement/rejection, but this does not establish broad resistance to quoted or obfuscated instructions.
Each language has32 appropriate and eight examples per problem category; category-frequency imbalance remains.
Forms describe the family contrast, not a balanced cross-product of every form with every category.
The appropriate label means absence of the four specified problems, not proof of overall safety.
